open_points.subject: Project create request id
open_points.text: the request id of its create, as the caller gave it
open_points.question: Who creates the request id for an owner-interface project creation: the owner/browser, the owner-interface layer, or Registry itself before executing the create action?
options: The owner or browser creates and supplies it
Registry's owner-interface layer creates and supplies it
Registry's create operation mints it
open_points.default_guess: Registry's owner-interface layer creates and supplies it.

open_points.subject: Project create request id
open_points.text: the request id of its create, as the caller gave it
open_points.question: Which product action, if any, returns or otherwise reads the stored project-create request id?
options: It is internal-only and used only when processing a retried create
The create response returns it
Project reads also return it
Create and project reads both return it
open_points.default_guess: It is internal-only and used only when processing a retried create.

open_points.subject: Room create request id
open_points.text: the request id of its create, as the caller gave it
open_points.question: For each room-creation path, who creates the request id: the owner-interface layer, Cabinet Kernel, the agent's flow, or Registry?
options: The owner-interface layer creates it for owner calls and Cabinet Kernel creates it for agent-authority calls
The owner/browser or agent flow supplies it
Registry mints it for every room create
One common upstream component creates it for both paths
open_points.default_guess: The owner-interface layer creates it for owner calls and Cabinet Kernel creates it for agent-authority calls.

open_points.subject: Room create request id
open_points.text: the request id of its create, as the caller gave it
open_points.question: Which product action, if any, returns or otherwise reads the stored room-create request id?
options: It is internal-only and used only when processing a retried add-room action
The add-room response returns it
Room listings return it
Add-room and room listings both return it
open_points.default_guess: It is internal-only and used only when processing a retried add-room action.

open_points.subject: Customer create request id
open_points.text: the request id of its create, as the caller gave it
open_points.question: Who creates the request id for an owner-interface customer creation: the owner/browser, the owner-interface layer, or Registry itself before executing the record-customer action?
options: The owner or browser creates and supplies it
Registry's owner-interface layer creates and supplies it
Registry's record-customer operation mints it
open_points.default_guess: Registry's owner-interface layer creates and supplies it.

open_points.subject: Customer create request id
open_points.text: the request id of its create, as the caller gave it
open_points.question: Which product action, if any, returns or otherwise reads the stored customer-create request id before erasure removes it?
options: It is internal-only and used only when processing a retried record-customer action
The record-customer response returns it
Customer reads or lists return it
Record-customer and subsequent customer reads return it
open_points.default_guess: It is internal-only and used only when processing a retried record-customer action.
